p.s: THE BEST WAY TO TRAVEL IS IN A GROUP LED BY A TOUR GUIDE
I am agree with the statement because when you travel with a tour guide you have the chance to go to the most interesting places of the country you are visiting.
You can also meet the bether cultural, historical, and representative places, that you would n't know if you dont go with a tour guide.

For example, when you go to Buenos Aires, Argentina, is better that you do it with a tourist agent, because they would take you to the most historical and representative places of the city and you will know their history and learn special information about them.
When you go there you cant miss the neihgborhood La Boca, the place in wich is located the stadium of the best club team in latin america, "Club Atletico Boca Juniors".
It 's a very beatiful place to walk but you have to go with a tour guide because in other way you would'nt appreciate all the history that is behind it.
If you travel alone, you will miss the chance to learn something new, and to live experiences like meeting new people from all above the world.
It is difficult that when you go into a trip by yourself, you wil meet all the pople that you can meet in a guided tour for the city.
In that way you could not just learn about the country you visit, but also about other countries in the world that you could go on a later trip to visit.
The advantages of going on a trip with a tour guide are huge.
You can not miss the chance of doing it, because on that way you will live the best vacational experience of your life.
You can learn about other countries customes and live for some days like a person of that country.
